full_name: Susan Slyomovics | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Susan Slyomovics conducts research on the expressive culture of the Middle East and North Africa, gender and human rights, the overlap between oral and written literature, and the relationship between visual anthropology and literature.
